Team — filing this here so we have a single thread that covers approvals.

Summary: Acme (Sanjay, Megan) is asking for a deeper per-token discount in exchange for a 12-month commit (expected avg 6B tokens/mo; peaks ~10B). They want a blended floor ~50% off list at high volume. Procurement asked for a written custom quote and SLA.

What I need from finance/legal:
- Acceptable discount banding vs list for USD-denominated annual commits (guidance on % off list at 6B, 8B, 10B tokens/mo).
- Whether we can offer a winterized true-up (quarterly) with no retroactive clawbacks aside from overage billing.
- Any mandatory contract clauses (minimum MOQ, termination fees) we should include for custom pricing.

I've attached the draft proposal (one-pager) and the latest public rate card for reference. If this can be approved at Director level, I can send the external quote; if it exceeds thresholds, please flag who needs to sign off.

Attachments: 20270411_acme_pricing_proposal.pdf, redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf

Subject: Re: Internal: Acme asks for deeper custom per-token floor (need guidance)

Priyom — thanks for the details, and good to see the forecast attached. A few notes from finance/legal perspective:

1) Discount guardrails: Director-level approval can greenlight up to 30% off list for an annualized committed spend >= $1.2M. Anything deeper requires VP review. Historically, 40–50% off list has been reserved for multi-year, multi-region commitments or strategic partnerships with guaranteed minimums and revenue protections.

2) Term & true-ups: Quarterly true-ups with pro-rated overage billing are fine. We prefer a minimum 12-month commitment for custom floors. Add a binary annual true-up to allow re-banding if actuals differ by >30% vs forecast.

3) SLAs & operational mitigations: Procurement requested throughput SLOs — we can commit to a 99.9% API availability SLA for Dedicated routing (if they choose reserved capacity) or a best-effort for hosted. If they want hosted with custom pricing, limit to 99.5% and include credit-based remedies, not cash refunds.

4) Required docs: Include a clause for usage data sharing and audit rights for first 12 months. Procurement will ask.

Recommendation: Offer a two-tier custom band —
- Band A (conservative): 10% off list at >= 6B tokens/mo, 12-month term.
- Band B (aggressive; Director-approved ceiling): 30% off list at >= 8B tokens/mo with quarterly true-ups and a 12-month term.

If you think Acme will push for 40%+, escalate to me and I'll pull in VP. We need to be explicit that anything below our published floor requires procurement to accept data/audit clauses.

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Sanjay / Megan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per procurement and our internal guidance, attached is a short, optional two-band quote:

Option 1 — Band A (conservative):
- Eligibility: >= 6B tokens/month average for 12 months
- Pricing: 15% off published list (blended per-token floor)
- True-up: Quarterly, pro-rated overage billing
- SLA: Hosted API (99.5% availability), credit-based remedy

Option 2 — Band B (aggressive — Director-approved):
- Eligibility: >= 8B tokens/month average for 12 months
- Pricing: 30% off published list (blended per-token floor)
- True-up: Quarterly with annual re-band if usage deviates >30%
- SLA: Option to move to Dedicated routing for 99.9% availability (additional infra fee)

Notes:
- These quotes are valid for 14 days. To accept, sign the DocuSign link included in the attachment.
- Deeper discounts (40%+) require VP-level signoff and multi-year commitments.

Attachments: 20270411_acme_pricing_proposal.pdf
